# ZerynBot V2 (Zeryn)

> Next-Generation Multi-Purpose Discord Bot & Web Management Dashboard powered by Python 3.10+, discord.py v2, Flask, In-Memory RAM Cache, and Full 6-Language i18n Localization. Specially optimized for 24/7 low-resource ARM environments (Android Termux, Raspberry Pi).

## Core Documentation

- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): Full technical architecture, database schema, component map, ARM optimizations, and anti-patterns.
- [E2E_TESTING.md](E2E_TESTING.md): End-to-end browser testing guide and test scenarios for Web Dashboard.
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, feature breakdown, setup instructions, and deployment guide.
- [.agents/AGENTS.md](.agents/AGENTS.md): AI Agent operational rules, environment context, and system conventions.
- [.agents/skills/zerynbot_architecture_context/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/zerynbot_architecture_context/SKILL.md): Standard operating procedures (SOP) and 5-step command creation checklist.

## System Architecture & Technical Specifications

- **Runtime**: Python 3.10+ on ARM64 Linux / Android Termux 24/7.
- **Entry Point**: `python main.py` (Central CLI process orchestrator for start, stop, restart, status, test).
- **Discord Bot**: `discord.py` v2.x with Hybrid Slash Commands (`app_commands`).
- **Web Dashboard**: Flask 3.x with Jinja2 templates, Discord OAuth2 authentication (`https://zerynbot.id.vn/callback`).
- **Database**: SQLite in WAL mode (`data/bot.db`) with `PRAGMA busy_timeout = 15000` and automated 24h `.zip` backups routed to private `BACKUP_DB` webhook.
- **Cache Layer**: Pure Python In-Memory RAM Cache (`cache.py`) with thread-safe/async-safe TTL eviction.
- **Internationalization (i18n)**: 6 synchronized dictionaries (`vi`, `en`, `zh`, `es`, `pt`, `fr`) with 1587 keys per file.
- **Audio Pipeline**: `yt-dlp` (`player_client: ["android", "web"]`) + `FFmpegOpusAudio` with single-thread optimization (`-threads 1 -fflags +genpts -af aresample=async=1:first_pts=0`), dual-tier caching (RAM Cache + SQLite disk cache `music_song_cache` with 6-hour TTL, <0.8s playback start), Music | 2 compact player card UI, progress bar, 5 interactive buttons, and `/nowplaying`.
- **DevOps & MCP Integration**: Model Context Protocol integration (`mcp_config.json`, `uvx mcp-server-sqlite`, and `scripts/termux_mcp.py` mapped to `main.py` CLI over Paramiko SSH port 8022 via LAN or Tailscale Mesh).
- **Image Generation**: Pillow (`PIL`) for dynamic rank cards, welcome/goodbye banners, and level cards.
- **AI Routing**: Groq Cloud (`qwen/qwen3.8-27b` default, `gpt-oss-20b`, `compound`), Google Gemini, and OpenRouter with Multimodal Vision and Admin Model Selector (`global_ai_model`).
- **Security & Concurrency Defense**: SSRF defense-in-depth (`is_safe_http_url` with DNS resolution, private/loopback/decimal IP blocking, 5MB stream limit), Stored XSS immunity in Embed Builder (DOM `textContent`, `<script type="application/json">`), cross-guild IDOR isolation (`member.guild.get_channel()`), and atomic conditional SQL updates (`WHERE wallet >= ?`) with single-connection transactions preventing SQLite deadlocks.

## 20 Active Modules

1. **welcome_goodbye**: Dynamic Pillow welcome/goodbye banner cards with custom avatar borders and localized messages.
2. **autoroles**: Automatic role assignment for regular members and bots upon joining.
3. **leveling**: Chat & Voice XP calculation, dynamic Pillow rank cards, and role reward milestones.
4. **utility**: Ping, server member count, multi-language interactive `/help` Command Center, poll, roll, choose.
5. **info**: Localized `/serverinfo`, `/userinfo`, `/avatar`, `/botinfo`, `/roleinfo`, `/channelinfo`.
6. **music**: High-performance audio player, Spotify auto-resolver, `/volume` (1-150%), `/shuffle`, `/nowplaying`, Lofi 24/7 radio, compact card UI with right thumbnail, progress bar, and 5 interactive buttons.
7. **tickets**: Support ticket panel builder with persistent views and private support channels.
8. **reactionroles**: Interactive button and reaction role assignment panels.
9. **automods**: Real-time multi-layer filter (Anti-Spam, Banned Words, Phishing Links, Anti-Invite, Anti-Caps, Mass Ping).
10. **logger**: Discord audit logging engine for message edits/deletions, member join/leave/kick/ban, role/channel updates.
11. **giveaways**: Essential Bot style giveaway manager with dark banner header, structured fields, role restrictions, and real-time counter.
12. **economy**: Separated Wallet (gambling `/coinflip`, `/slots`, `/blackjack`, `/pay`, `/work`, `/fish`, `/hunt`, `/sell`) and Bank (safe custody `/deposit`, `/withdraw`, `/inventory` and `/shop` checkout).
13. **tempvoice**: Join-to-Create voice hubs with in-chat button controls (Lock, Limit, Rename, Kick) and auto-deletion.
14. **customcommands**: Custom command triggers and auto-responders with variable replacements (`{user}`, `{server}`, `{members}`).
15. **ai**: Groq Cloud (`qwen/qwen3.8-27b`, `gpt-oss-20b`, `compound`), Google Gemini, OpenRouter AI assistant (`/ask`, `/summarize`, `#ai-chat`, Bot Owner persona, Vision support, DuckDuckGo web search, SSRF guard).
16. **remind**: Scheduled smart reminders and timers (`/remindme`, `/reminders`, `/delreminder`) with 15s background watchdog.
17. **moderation**: Comprehensive moderation suite (`/kick`, `/ban`, `/unban`, `/timeout`, `/untimeout`, `/warn`, `/warnings`, `/delwarn`, `/clear`, `/slowmode`, `/lock`, `/unlock`).
18. **fun**: Anime GIF social interactions (10 actions via nekos.best: `/hug`, `/pat`, `/kiss`, `/slap`, `/feed`, `/cuddle`, `/poke`, `/highfive`, `/cry`, `/dance`), love compatibility `/ship`, interactive proposal `/marry`, `/divorce`, `/profile`.
19. **birthday**: Member birthday tracking (`/birthday set`, `/birthday check`, `/birthday list`, `/birthday remove`), automated 00:00 midnight celebration embeds, temporary 24h Birthday VIP role, and bank coins/XP bonuses.
20. **verify**: Verification Gate (CAPTCHA / button-based verification, `/setup_verify`, `/verify panel`, `/verify disable`), quarantine with pending roles, join-flood Anti-Raid lockdown, and Anti-Nuke admin safeguard.

## Key Project Files

- `main.py`: Primary controller and process supervisor.
- `config.py`: Environment configuration and security constants.
- `database.py`: Dual-mode SQLite engine (sync for Flask, async for Bot).
- `cache.py`: In-memory thread-safe caching.
- `i18n.py`: O(1) RAM translation engine.
- `bot/bot.py`: Main Discord bot entry point.
- `bot/cogs/`: 24 functional cogs containing 103 total commands across 17 categories.
- `dashboard/app.py`: Web dashboard routes and `_COMMANDS_DATA` central registry.
- `dashboard/api.py`: AJAX JSON endpoints for real-time dashboard updates.
- `scripts/termux_mcp.py`: MCP Server for remote Termux SSH operations and automated diagnostics.
- `locales/`: 6 locale dictionary files (1587 keys each).
